description: Smart-search filters for the Equipment History tab ONLY. One config file per tab, because oj-sp-smart-search renders a chip for EVERY filter the loaded config declares — suggestion-filters does NOT gate that row. Each `field` IS the endpoint's literal query-param name (see reportCriterion.ENDPOINT_PARAMS); a field that is not a real param yields a chip that filters nothing, because the views ignore unknown params silently. This set is deliberately CURATED, not exhaustive — the endpoint accepts more params than are offered. Not offered: Serial Number (free-text q still spans it); duration and fromDate/toDate — the window stays a page-level Period control (presets plus a Custom range), not a chip, because smart search has no date filter type. Project and Equipment Name WERE dropped for this reason too but were re-added as chips by request, alongside the equivalent addition on Equipment Analytics.
